description: consistencyLevel must be Strong, Session, Bounded, or Eventually

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: CollectionReq struct (no ConsistencyLevel field) -> createCollection() checks httpReq.Params['consistencyLevel'] (line 2043) -> JSON binding places consistencyLevel at top level, not in params -> Check fails -> Default Bounded used
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现根本原因:CollectionReq 结构体缺少 ConsistencyLevel 字段。JSON 反序列化时,请求中的 consistencyLevel 字段无法绑定到任何结构体字段,被静默忽略。代码仅检查 httpReq.Params['consistencyLevel'],但实际请求中 consistencyLevel 作为顶级字段传递,不在 params 内部。结果: 非法值绕过验证,默认值 Bounded 被使用。这是真正的 bug,不是 by-design。

falsification.observed: All 6 invalid values SUCCEEDED without error, all defaulted to 'Bounded'. Valid values ('Strong', 'Session', 'Bounded', 'Eventually') also work correctly. This confirms silent fallback rather than explicit rejection.

verdicts.rationale: DEFECT CONFIRMED. 根源:CollectionReq 结构体缺少 ConsistencyLevel 字段 (request_v2.go:690-703),导致 JSON 反序列化时该字段被静默忽略。createCollection() 仅检查 httpReq.Params['consistencyLevel'] (handler_v2.go:2043),但请求中 consistencyLevel 作为顶级字段传递,不在 params 内部,导致检查失败。非法值绕过验证,默认值 Bounded 被使用。这违反了契约 (milvus_type_collections_create_003: consistencyLevel in [Strong, Session, Bounded, Eventually])。实测验证: 6 个不同非法值全部成功创建,全部默认为 Bounded。4 个合法值也正常工作。这是真正的 bug,不是 by-design 或平凡解释。匹配历史盲点模式: REST v2 API 数据类型处理问题 (52232, 52230, 52229)。
